title: Self-erasure reports success after skipping recent-subscriber cleanup when the username lookup fails
current: If reddit.getCurrentUsername() fails during 'Remove My Own Data', the route logs a warning, skips eraseFromRecentSubscribers, and still shows the 'self success' toast.
evidence: The username is only used for the recent-subscriber cleanup. When it's missing, that step is skipped by an if, and nothing changes the response.
assumptions: Same as R-S9-04: whether ID-based erasure already covers the display fields.
investigate: If ID-based erasure doesn't cover the display fields, return the partial or failure toast when the username can't be resolved.

criticality.why: The user is told their data is gone when part of it may remain.
